Game Overview

Queens puts players into a puzzle experience centered on guide regal queens to their rightful thrones in this captivating 2D puzzle game. Strategically position each queen across intricate boards, ensuring no two share the same line of sight. Enjoy the challenge of clearing vibrant, color-coded puzzles while refining your spatial skills under the ticking clock.
